content.title: Dates Holy Week 2026
content.text: Seville Holy Week Dates Holy Week 2026 From March 29 to April 5, 2026 The processions in the historic center of Seville begin on Sunday, March 29 (Palm Sunday) and end on Sunday, April 5 (Easter Sunday). The dates of Holy Week vary each year because they are calculated based on the cycle of the lunar phases and the spring equinox, so the dates are not fixed on the calendar. In the days leading up to Palm Sunday, the city is filled with fervor, the air thick with the scent of incense, and the vibrant life of religious brotherhoods permeates every neighborhood. Good Friday and Holy Saturday are the prelude to Holy Week in Seville. What does each day of Holy Week mean? Palm Sunday marks Jesus' entry into Jerusalem, welcoming the Messiah with an olive or palm branch. Holy Monday marks the manifestation of Jesus' power before nature and the crowd. Holy Tuesday marks Jesus's prediction of his death to his disciples. Holy Wednesday is the last day of Lent and marks the beginning of Easter. Maundy Thursday commemorates Jesus' Last Supper with his apostles. Good Friday commemorates the crucifixion and death of Christ. Holy Saturday marks the awaiting of Jesus' Resurrection.
